subject.title: fix(memory): increase QMD embedTimeoutMs default to 600s for local GG…

question: Should OpenClaw make every unset QMD vector embed timeout 600s, or should the fix be narrowed until live QMD/GGUF proof shows the broad default is safe?
rationale: This PR changes a runtime default and lock budget for existing QMD users, and current issue discussion shows both premature 120s timeouts and long high-CPU embed runs as real operator concerns.

options.title: Require proof for the broad default
options.body: Keep the 600s default path only if live QMD/GGUF proof shows it resolves the target workload without unacceptable CPU/lock behavior.

options.title: Narrow the runtime change
options.body: Keep the warning/help improvement and use a selective local-GGUF or opt-in timeout strategy instead of changing every unset QMD vector setup.

options.title: Accept the compatibility tradeoff
options.body: Merge the broad default intentionally and own the longer CPU/process budget as the preferred QMD vector behavior.

recommendation.title: Require proof for the broad default
recommendation.body: Keep the 600s default path only if live QMD/GGUF proof shows it resolves the target workload without unacceptable CPU/lock behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR is currently assigned to osolmaz and recent history shows related QMD config/default work.
